   Villa Vie Odyssey was forced to dock. But the endless cruise’s real problem wasn’t oil
 The cruise industry is in pretty rude health in 2026.
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 The Villa Vie Residences’ cruise ship Odyssey docked at Sihanoukville port in Preah Sihanouk province on Oct 28.
 PHOTO: AFP
 David Fickling
 Published   Nov 02, 2026, 12:30 PM
 Updated   Nov 02, 2026, 06:16 PM
 Set as preferred source Unlock audio The saga of the Villa Vie Odyssey feels like the perfect metaphor for 2026: A year when the AI rich dreamed of a world beyond nation states and ordinary constraints, only to run aground on the brutal reality of scarce oil. 
 The cruise ship, on an open-ended voyage promising residents “the freedom of world travel with the comforts of home”, is  stranded in Cambodia  after saying it ran out of money for fuel.
